program: 智慧能源系统第一阶段 Simulator Acceptance
sourceDesign: 智慧能源系统测试与验收体系设计
scope: software-and-simulator-first; real field meter and formal endurance remain explicitly deferred

requirements.title: 关键需求可追踪到测试和证据
requirements.acceptance: Requirement -> Test Case -> Result 链路完整且静态校验通过

requirements.title: Phase 1 统一数据模型和跨域 Tenant 隔离不可回退
requirements.acceptance: Asset/Device/Point/Time Series/Energy Topology/Metric Definition 基线与 Command/Alarm/Work Order Tenant+Organization 双重隔离静态 Gate 通过

requirements.title: 中央机房固定 Simulator 数据集可重复运行
requirements.acceptance: 固定 Site/Gateway/Device/Point fixture 通过自动化回归

requirements.title: Edge Publisher -> MQTT -> Adapter -> S2 完整模拟链路
requirements.acceptance: 真实 Mosquitto + mTLS + QoS1 + 7 Devices + 当前 central-plant 全部 Point 通过

requirements.title: MQTT 临时下游故障可重试且 poison message 不污染 S2
requirements.acceptance: 注入 S2 503 后恢复；非法消息丢弃；Adapter 保持 ready

requirements.title: Gateway Topic ACL 和跨 Site 隔离
requirements.acceptance: 错误 Site publish 返回 MQTT v5 Not authorized

requirements.title: Replay/duplicate/out-of-order 不破坏当前状态语义
requirements.acceptance: 动态验证 REPLAYED/OUT_OF_ORDER delivery evidence、Source Position、Current State 不回退和重启后持久化

requirements.title: MQTT Broker 故障时 Edge Store & Forward 保持可恢复
requirements.acceptance: Broker stop 后 Publisher readiness=503、S2 停止收到实时数据、磁盘队列增长；Broker 恢复后缓存自动补传且队列归零

requirements.title: Gateway 进程重启后缓存与 Point Sequence 恢复
requirements.acceptance: 离线 MQTT 队列跨进程保留；当前全部 Point sequence 持久化；重启后新 Source Position offset 严格高于重启前持久最大值

requirements.title: PostgreSQL RLS、约束和 Tenant/Site 隔离真实执行
requirements.acceptance: 真实 PostgreSQL fixture 验证强制 RLS、唯一约束和跨 Scope 拒绝

requirements.title: 累计电量 Canonical Golden Dataset
requirements.acceptance: 正常增量、Source PARTIAL、canonical RESET 与 INVALID_DECREASE 排除均与冻结 Golden Dataset 一致

requirements.title: Counter Decrease 不伪造零能耗 Fact
requirements.acceptance: RESET 只消费 canonical non-negative delta；INVALID_DECREASE 不生成 Fact，也不得写 0 kWh 伪造事实

requirements.title: 历史 Telemetry 到 Energy Read Model/Cube 可重复投影
requirements.acceptance: ClickHouse History 与 Cube integration evidence 均通过

requirements.title: Alarm 生命周期和读模型回归
requirements.acceptance: Alarm contract、service、promotion preflight 和 Go tests 通过

requirements.title: 控制安全采用负向验收
requirements.acceptance: Command domain/dispatcher/connector 的确定性负向测试与安全边界测试全部通过

requirements.title: Command 重试、重复投递和并发单写保持单一结果
requirements.acceptance: 真实 PostgreSQL Command authority、idempotency、lease/concurrency 与治理分发测试通过

requirements.title: Command 必须以 Read Back Verification 判定结果
requirements.acceptance: Verification contract/PostgreSQL 流程证明 Mismatch/Timeout/Inconclusive 不得成为 VERIFIED

requirements.title: 正式 Command Certification 条件在生产控制前冻结
requirements.acceptance: Preflight 仅证明认证 envelope、零容忍计数器、容量/Crash Point/Canary 条件完整；不得声称真实 Device side effect 已验收

requirements.title: Telemetry/MQTT/Edge/Command/Alarm 可观测性资产一致
requirements.acceptance: Metric catalog、低基数规则、Dashboard、Alert、Runbook 静态 Gate 通过

requirements.title: PostgreSQL Backup 必须经过 Destroy + Restore 验证
requirements.acceptance: 隔离 Test DB 实际备份、删除、恢复后表集合/行数/RLS/fixture 一致

requirements.title: 生产依赖许可证和 Go 已知漏洞 Gate
requirements.acceptance: 许可证策略通过且 Go workspace 无已知漏洞

requirements.title: 容量目标与 Failure Scenario 在正式压测前被冻结
requirements.acceptance: 仅作为配置 Preflight；不得声称完成 60min/15min 正式容量测试

requirements.title: 真实电表 Modbus 接入与 Vendor Template Certification
requirements.acceptance: 等待真实电表/协议资料后验证 Address/DataType/Endian/Scale/Unit/Mapping

requirements.title: 现场计量值、方向、单位与平台人工比对
requirements.acceptance: 等待真实计量设备后执行 Lab -> Single Device -> Small Site 验收

requirements.title: 24-72h Endurance 和正式 values/s 容量验收
requirements.acceptance: 需要专用 Staging、硬件资源清单和 wall-clock attestation

requirements.title: 浏览器 E2E/UAT 和 Production Acceptance
requirements.acceptance: 需要 Linux CDP browser、角色化 UAT 与发布候选环境

requirements.title: Realtime + Historical Replay 混合负载优先级与容量验收
requirements.acceptance: 需要 Staging 混合负载证明历史补传不拖垮实时流，并记录 realtime/replay lag、queue 和资源曲线

requirements.title: Gateway 磁盘压力、队列上限与保留策略故障注入
requirements.acceptance: 需要受控磁盘压力环境验证高水位告警、queue limit、清理/保留策略与核心采集降级行为

requirements.title: RPO/RTO 定量灾难恢复验收
requirements.acceptance: 当前已证明可 Restore；RPO/RTO 仍需带时间戳的正式故障演练和恢复窗口证据
